mirobot_base.origin: controller Cartesian zero; not the home flange, paper zero, or table surface
mirobot_base.abc: extrinsic fixed-axis XYZ; R_MF = Rz(C) Ry(B) Rx(A)

quaternion.sign: align to reference or previous orientation

initial_pose.measurement: actual initial_ready Cartesian state must be recorded each session

tool.file_specific_source: source.gcode ; tool marker; absent marker uses existing legacy rule

paper.origin: intersection of paper top boundary and printed-0 centreline

axes.x: top of fixed initial reference photo
axes.y: left of fixed initial reference photo

paper.registration_status: requires paired physical reference points; not measured

depth_camera.depth: native uint16 multiplied by device-reported depth_scale; zero depth is invalid
depth_camera.pixel_alignment: native depth pixels are not assumed to be RGB pixels; use SDK intrinsics/extrinsics
depth_camera.registration_status: unmeasured and depends on arm configuration

raw_telemetry.raw: full decoded status response, CR/LF removed
raw_telemetry.angle_field_order: retain firmware Angle(ABCDXYZ) order; joint mapping unconfirmed
raw_telemetry.pump_pwm: reported signal, not independently measured finger width

transform_convention: p_destination = R_destination_from_source * p_source + t_destination_from_source; convert units first
independent_validation: fit at least three non-collinear shared points; check a separately measured fourth point
